independence_notes: NHS and RCUK are distinct writing bodies with shared UK recommendations.
ASCIA September 2026 explicitly aligns its definition with WAO; agreement is not independent empirical confirmation.
AAAAI, ACAAI and international guidelines share research; article writers are separately identified.
MedlinePlus encyclopedia is A.D.A.M. authored: new scoped source ID corrects attribution without changing shared metadata.
MedlinePlus food-testing summary cites ACAAI; counted as independently edited summary only, not independent research.
regional_differences: Five-minute repeat is explicitly UK NHS/RCUK auto-injector/IM advice; WAO gives a 5–15 minute professional range.
Observation varies: ASCIA minimum/overnight criteria and UK risk-stratified approach are not converted into a universal fixed discharge threshold.
Some US sources permit pre-agreed help-seeking plans after rescue medication; first, uncertain, persistent or worsening attacks retain emergency advice.
US prescription nasal epinephrine exists; no claim of approval or availability in China or every region, and no dose/weight eligibility invented.
